title: MORNING
tod: 06:12 → 06:26 · winter dawn, cold blue exterior / warm interior
logline: The world before the world changes. A room, a clock, a boy who believes today will be identical to yesterday.
grade: Cool cyan shadows (#1B2A3A) against a single warm sunrise shaft (#FFC98A). Low saturation, high contrast, soft halation on the sun edge only.

narration.hi: कभी-कभी ज़िंदगी में कुछ ऐसा होने वाला होता है, जिसका हमें ज़रा भी अंदाज़ा नहीं होता।
narration.en: Sometimes life is about to do something to us that we haven't the faintest idea of.

narration.hi: हम रोज़ की तरह उठते हैं, तैयार होते हैं, स्कूल जाते हैं... और सोचते हैं कि आज का दिन भी बाकी दिनों जैसा ही होगा।
narration.en: We wake as always, get ready, go to school… and assume today will be just like every other day.

narration.hi: मैं भी कुछ ऐसा ही सोचता था।

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.55 m, locked off on a tripod at the foot of the bed, window at frame-left edge
shots.move: Static. Fade in from black over 1.5 s. No zoom.
shots.action: Empty-feeling room. Curtain breathes once in a draught. Dust motes drift through the sun shaft. No human movement.
shots.env: Bedroom: bed house-left, study desk house-right, wardrobe on the back wall, half-drawn curtain across a tall window.
shots.light: One hard low-angle sun shaft (≈12° above horizon) raking across the floor; cold 5600K ambient fill; practical bedside lamp OFF.
shots.vfx: Dust motes in the shaft, faint anamorphic bloom on the shaft edge only.
shots.vo: Narration line 1 enters at 00:04, over the empty room — deliberately before we see him.
shots.cont: Curtain must be drawn to exactly 2/3. Clock reads 06:12. Blanket smooth, one pillow dented.

shots.cam: Tabletop height, 20 cm from the digital clock, 3/4 angle
shots.move: Static. Rack focus from the clock body to the digits at 00:14.
shots.env: Bedside table: clock, a glass of water, a school ID card face-down, tangled charger cable.
shots.light: A thin warm slit of sun crosses only the digits; the rest of the frame sits in blue shadow.
shots.vfx: None. This is the film's 'honest' shot — zero effects, maximum cleanliness.
shots.vo: Line 2 begins at 00:22, one beat after the digits settle.
shots.cont: Digits must read 06:15 and hold until S01-05. Clock model is registered as prop P-01.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.25 m, at the side of the bed, looking slightly down at 8°
shots.move: Very slow dolly-in, 0.35 m/s, motive: entering his private world.
shots.action: Asleep on his side, one arm out of the blanket, fingers curled. Chest rises and falls.
shots.expr: Fully relaxed; mouth slightly open; brow smooth.
shots.env: L01 bedroom, headboard against the back wall, school bag slumped on the floor.
shots.light: Warm rim along the cheek and shoulder from the sun shaft; face 70% in cool shadow.
shots.vfx: Dust motes; blanket fibre detail; no glow.
shots.vo: Line 2 continues — the narration is describing him while he is unconscious.
shots.cont: Hair falls over his LEFT eyebrow — lock this direction in every sleeping/reclining shot.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.15 m, 50 cm from his face, eye-line level
shots.move: Near-static with 1-px handheld breathing. No dolly.
shots.action: Eyes open. Three slow blinks. Pupils contract as they find the window. He does not move his head.
shots.expr: Sleep-fogged → mildly annoyed → resigned. Micro-performance only, no big expression.
shots.env: Same, background softly defocused, curtain glow behind.
shots.light: Warm key across the bridge of the nose; cool fill keeps the far side of the face readable.
shots.vo: Line 2 ends; 3 s of pure room tone before line 3.
shots.cont: Eye colour: dark brown, amber flecks at 4 o'clock in both irises — identical in every CU.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.4 m, near the wardrobe, looking across the bed
shots.move: Slow lateral dolly left→right, 0.5 m/s, following the stretch.
shots.action: Pushes himself upright, sits on the edge, stretches both arms overhead, yawns, scratches the back of his head.
shots.expr: Eyes still half-closed; jaw cracks in the yawn; a small involuntary smile at the end.
shots.env: L01 bedroom, morning light now stronger and warmer.
shots.light: Sun shaft has moved 4° across the floor — the room is warming shot by shot.
shots.vo: Line 3 at 00:52 — 'I thought the same thing' lands on the yawn. Understated, almost throwaway.
shots.cont: Clock in background must show 06:15+. Blanket now crumpled — do not re-smooth it for the rest of the scene.

shots.cam: Starts over his shoulder at 1.5 m, then swings to a trailing 3/4 rear track
shots.move: Smooth 90° arc + follow, steadicam, no shake, ends behind his right shoulder.
shots.action: He stands, walks across the room, kicks a slipper into place, and reaches the bathroom door.
shots.expr: Neutral; eyes on the floor; one hand rubbing the back of his neck.
shots.env: Bedroom → short hallway → bathroom door. Door frame on the right third.
shots.light: Backlit by the window; he reads almost as a silhouette with a warm edge.
shots.vo: Silence. Let the footsteps we cannot hear be felt in the body language.
shots.cont: Door is on the RIGHT wall of the hallway (geography lock G-01). Slippers: dark grey, left one scuffed.

shots.cam: Interior, height 1.30 m, focused on the door handle, shallow depth
shots.move: Static. He pushes the door; light floods; slow 6-frame dissolve to Scene 2.
shots.action: Hand closes on the handle, turns it, door swings inward and warm light spills over his fingers.
shots.env: Bathroom door, painted off-white, small brass handle, a towel hook at frame-right.
shots.light: Practical bathroom light beyond the door: warm 3000K, blooming into the cold hallway.
shots.vfx: Gentle overexposure bloom on the door edge as it opens.
shots.vo: Line 3 finishes by 00:58, then 60 s of narration-free room tone carries us to the cut.
shots.cont: First appearance of the film's recurring motif: light arriving from behind a door.
